description: This file defines a base class for all ResultSet classes in a Perl DBIx::Class schema, including methods for counting distinct values, selecting only ID columns, and asserting no statement handle is active. It also loads several helper components and enforces certain usage constraints.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet
classes.description: Base class for all ResultSet classes in the Coocook schema, providing common methods and component loading.

methods.name: count_distinct
methods.description: Returns the count of distinct values in a specified column.

methods.name: only_id_col
methods.description: Returns a new ResultSet selecting only the specified ID column.

methods.name: assert_no_sth
methods.description: Checks if a statement handle is active and croaks if so, to prevent concurrent statement execution.
